C-35.Name: Website refresh in the ¶ paper/ink/marker style, mobile-first, with Mac install bar and Avenex-grade SEO/consent/security
C-35.Summary: Rebuild mark.xronocode.com (VitePress docs + 58 KB hand-built landing on GitHub Pages) in the new brand system from the icon and store screenshots. Mobile first: the current page is ≈10 iPhone screens long and the cookie banner covers the hero. Carry over the Avenex outreach site practices (numbered sections, single accent, no-flash theme, self-hosted Plex subsets, 980/520 breakpoints with dvh/safe-area, browser screenshot matrix, per-language SEO and OG images, JSON-LD SoftwareApplication, llms.txt, hashed CSP headers, geo-gated Consent Mode v2, GA4 download_click).

Problem.Description: The site still shows the old cyan-M brand and outdated facts (11 MB, 21 themes); mobile UX is weak; no install path on iPhone for a Mac-only app.

Goals.R-1: S1 design system + mobile prototype on the canvas (paper/ink/marker tokens, type scale, components) approved before code.
Goals.R-2: S2 landing rebuild: hero with live product demo (agent writes → Mark reloads), sections mirroring the 6 store frames, honest verified numbers; Mac install CTA; iPhone/iPad sticky «Mark for Mac» bar with Web Share «send to Mac» (AirDrop/Messages/Notes) + copy link; apple-itunes-app meta for Safari on macOS; cookie banner never over the hero.
Goals.R-3: S3 SEO/analytics/security: per-language canonical + hreflang, OG images per language, JSON-LD SoftwareApplication, sitemap with alternates, llms.txt, security.txt, hashed-CSP + security headers, consent.js re-synced with Avenex, download_click event.
Goals.R-4: S4 all 10 languages in one release, docs pages restyled; browser screenshot matrix 320/390/574/1440 + landscape as a CI gate.
Goals.R-5: S5 hosting decision: stay on GitHub Pages or move to Cloudflare (needed if C-36 assistant ships on the site).

C-35.Dependencies: C-23 (site shows 2.3.0 features); C-36 for the assistant widget slot.

Constraints.Constraint: Every number fact-checked against a source; no employer/client names (leak grep); all languages ship together; no third-party trademarks in imagery.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Lighthouse mobile ≥ 95 performance/accessibility/SEO; screenshot matrix passes; every number fact-checked; leak grep clean.

AffectedAreas.Site: site/ (VitePress config, landing, public assets, consent.js, headers), .github/workflows/site

C-35.VerificationIntent: Browser screenshot matrix, Lighthouse CI, link checker (site/scripts/check-dist.mjs), fact-check log.
